exercises.title: Single-leg landing drills
exercises.description: Practice controlled single-leg drop-landings focusing on knee-over-toe alignment to retrain landing mechanics and reduce valgus collapse.

exercises.title: Eccentric landing control training
exercises.description: Landings show a hard/abrupt deceleration pattern. Practice 'stick the landing' drills with a 2-3 second controlled eccentric phase to build shock absorption.

strengthening.title: Hip abductor & glute medius strengthening
strengthening.description: Elevated knee valgus was detected during movement, which is commonly linked to weak hip abductors. Add lateral band walks, clamshells, and single-leg glute bridges 3x/week.

recovery_plan.title: Maintain standard recovery protocol
recovery_plan.description: No elevated fatigue or risk signals detected. Continue standard recovery practices: adequate sleep, hydration, and periodized training load.
